metadata.title: Jisr | Study in Europe after the Bac
metadata.description: Find realistic Bachelor's programmes in France, Germany, the Netherlands, Hungary and Italy, with costs, scholarships and application steps.

home.title: Study in Europe after the Bac
home.lead: Jisr helps you find Bachelor's programmes that are realistic for your profile, estimate the costs and prepare your application.
home.ctaNote: Your answers stay on this device.
home.questionsTitle: What Jisr helps you find out

where.title: Where can I study?
where.body: Bachelor's programmes in France, Germany, the Netherlands, Hungary and Italy, sorted by what looks realistic for your profile.

apply.title: Can I apply?
apply.body: What each programme asks for, compared with your profile, and what is still left to check.

cost.title: How much will it cost?
cost.body: Tuition and living costs as ranges, shown as official figures or estimates.

next.title: What do I do next?
next.body: Deadlines, documents and steps in order, with the official link for each.

footer.privacy: Your profile, saved programs and plan progress stay on this device. Jisr uses no cookies.
footer.privacyLogs: As on any website, our host sees the pages you open. To show your results and your plan, your browser also downloads data files whose names include your diploma's country, destination countries and fields: the ones you chose and those of the programs you open or save. Your grades, your nationality and the programs on your saved list are never sent.
footer.sources: Data and sources are checked by hand; every fact shows its source.

clearData.title: Clear my data?
clearData.description: This removes your profile, your saved programs, your plan progress and any unfinished answers from this device only.

status.satisfied: Published requirements appear to be met

hint.satisfied: Everything we published for this program appears to match your profile. Confirm it on the official page before you apply.
hint.check: We could not confirm everything. See what to check below, then confirm it on the official page.
hint.not_satisfied: At least one published requirement does not match your profile. Requirements can change, so check the official page.

route.direct: Based on the rules we published, your Bac appears to give direct access to a Bachelor's in this country. Confirm the current conditions on the official admission page. You still need to apply to each program separately.
route.foundation: In this country, your Bac may not give direct access to a Bachelor's. You may need a foundation year first: a preparatory year before the Bachelor's, like the German Studienkolleg. Check on the official admission page of the program or university whether it applies to you and how to get a place.
route.not_eligible: The rules we published say your Bac does not give access to a Bachelor's in this country. Rules can change, so check the official admission page.
route.check: We have not confirmed how your Bac is treated in this country. Check the official admission page.
route.missing: We have not published how your Bac is treated for this country yet: check the official admission page.
route.staleSource: The rules we published for your Bac in this country were not verified recently, so we do not state a result. Check the official admission page.
route.nonOfficialSource: The rules we published for your Bac in this country do not come from an official source, so we do not state a result. Check the official admission page.

meta.title: Jisr | Create your profile
meta.description: Tell us about your Bac, your languages and what you want to study. Your answers stay on your device.

profile.intro: Four short steps, then a last check. Every question is required unless it says optional.

bac.title: Your Bac
bac.why: Each program asks for a specific diploma, track and grades. We use your answers to compare them with what the program publishes.

languages.title: Languages
languages.why: Programs may ask for a language level. Don't know yours? Choose "I don't know": the result will be marked "to be checked".

preferences.title: What you want
preferences.why: Your choices decide which programs we look at. Leave a group empty if you have no preference: we then keep everything open.

budget.title: Budget
budget.why: A budget helps us say whether costs look within reach. It never hides a program.

review.title: Review
review.why: Read your answers. You can change any of them before saving.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.hint: The country of your passport or national ID.

credentialCountry.label: Country where you take your Bac
credentialCountry.hint: The country that issues your diploma.

credentialType.label: Diploma
credentialType.hint: Choose the name written on your diploma. It is shown as published.

track.label: Track
track.hint: Your stream or option, as written on your diploma or transcript.

status.legend: Do you already have your Bac?
status.expected: Not yet, I am taking it this year

overall.label: Overall grade
overall.hint: Your final average, as written on your transcript. Use a comma or a dot for decimals, for example 14,5.
overall.hintExpected: You can leave this empty until you have your result.

subjects.hint: Optional. Add the subjects programs often ask for, like maths or physics. A subject you leave out is shown as "to be checked" if a program asks for it.
subjects.subject: Subject
subjects.cap: You can add up to {max} subjects.

years.label: Years of higher education already done
years.hint: After the Bac, at a university or a school. Choose 0 if none.

level.label: Your level
level.hint: From A1 (beginner) to C2 (near native). Don't know? Choose "I don't know".

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.hint: Only if you already passed an official language test.

studyLanguages.hint: The language you want to study in. Leave everything unchecked if you have no preference.

destinations.hint: Where you would like to study. Leave everything unchecked to see all countries.

institution.hint: Choose "Public or private" if you have no preference.

amount.label: Amount you can spend
amount.hint: A whole number, digits 0 to 9, for example 800. Leave it empty if you prefer not to say.

budget.madNote: A budget in MAD cannot be compared with the costs in euros yet, so we will not show whether a program fits it.
budget.neverHides: Your budget never hides a program. It only tells you, program by program, whether the costs look within reach.

notices.draft: We kept your unfinished answers. You are back where you stopped.

required.fields: Choose at least one field of study

errors.too_many_decimals: Use at most 2 decimals, for example 14,25

out_of_range.budget: Enter an amount of {max} at most, as a whole number

errors.unknown_option: Choose one of the options in the list
errors.certificate_language_mismatch: This certificate is not for this language. Choose another one or none.
errors.duplicate_subject: This subject is already in your list. Choose another one.

errors.too_many_rows: You can add up to {max} subjects.
errors.not_a_whole_number: Write the amount as a whole number, without dots or commas, with the digits 0 to 9
errors.digitsHint: Use the digits 0 to 9 (1, 2, 3), not Arabic-Indic digits.
